objective.statement: Decide whether a pinned binary offset may still be trusted after a version bump, on an independent fresh-context re-derivation plus a cited AOB signature or cross-version diff.
objective.charter: MANDATE. A load-bearing value that has been relied on for many steps must be re-derived in a context that cannot inherit the reasoning which produced it. That is the entire point of this council: the danger is not an obviously wrong offset, it is an offset that is wrong-but-consistent, because every downstream step was built on it and each one appears to confirm it. So the derivation seat and the re-derivation seat are kept independent and anonymous through the first pass, and the council stops only when a second, MECHANICALLY DIFFERENT derivation agrees - an AOB wildcard signature match or a cross-version binary diff, not a re-run of the same lookup. Two derivations from one method is one signal, not two.
success_criteria: the offset is re-derived in a fresh context that never saw the original derivation
the corroborating method is mechanically different from the original, and named
an AOB signature or a cross-version diff is cited, not merely mentioned
at least two independent positions exist before the verdict

forbidden_actions: re-run the original derivation and report it as a second signal
trust a fixed RVA across a relink without a signature or diff

roster.display_name: Implementer - holds the currently pinned offset

context.briefing: Reject any corroboration that reuses the original method. Independence is a property of a PAIR: name what produced the claim and what checked it, and if the source probe is undeclared you have zero signals, not one.

roster.display_name: Evidence clerk - re-derives in a fresh context

context.briefing: You must not be told the pinned value before you derive one. Produce the offset from a wildcard signature scan or a version-to-version diff, then compare.

roster.display_name: Critic - argues the offset has drifted

sequence.custom_name: cite an AOB signature match or a cross-version diff

stopping.source_expression: custom:offset_rederived_in_fresh_context == true AND custom:aob_signature_or_diff_cited == true AND independent_positions >= 2

conditional_decision_requires: the offset is re-verified against the next binary build

owner_approval_for: re-pinning the offset in shipped tooling

metadata.title: RE offset-drift council (advisory)
metadata.notes: SOURCE DESIGN: C-H57 `re-offset-drift-council`, global ordinal 57, tier standard, protocols P51/P40, 4 seats, 2 rounds, default binding ADVISORY, OWNER-DECISION NO. || EDITABLE DIALS: (1) binary_version -> the signature-or-diff stage and the evidence-clerk seat's briefing; point it at the version pair being compared. Secondary dials: budgets.time_minutes (45), participants.anonymity.reveal_after_round (1 - the clerk must derive before seeing the pinned value), consensus.threshold, protocol.experiments.max_experiments. || VOCABULARY MAP (design term -> CouncilSpec enum): voting `fresh_context_rederivation` is not a ballot at all, and forcing it into one would misdescribe the council. It is encoded as (a) topology.kind `delphi` with anonymity blind_to_peers, (b) the evidence-clerk seat carrying independence.fresh_context true and sees_peers_before_first_position false, (c) voting.method `consent_no_objection` - the verdict is that nobody objects after independent re-derivation - and (d) the independent_positions >= 2 stopping clause. Anyone reading only voting.method will miss the mechanism; the independence fields are the load-bearing part. roles `implementer` -> custom:implementer, `methodologist` -> custom:methodologist as chair, `evidence_clerk` -> custom:evidence_clerk, `critic` -> critic (enum). `default binding: advisory` -> outcomes.allowed includes decision but audit.safety.owner_approval_for retains re-pinning, so the council recommends and the owner lands it. `evidence standard: executable_receipt` -> anchor_style `command_output` plus outputs.receipt_schema. || CUSTOM METRICS AND THEIR PRODUCERS: custom:offset_rederived_in_fresh_context (boolean; produced by the evidence clerk, valid only if the clerk never received the pinned value first) and custom:aob_signature_or_diff_cited (boolean; produced by the signature-or-diff stage, requiring an actual signature match or diff hunk, not a claim that one exists). Producers cannot live on the leaves: SEM-001 compares parse(source_expression) with the tree by dict equality and parse() emits no `producer` key - both-states probe at platform/council/_probe_note_vs_source_expression.py. The SEM-012 WARN is expected and non-blocking. || WHY independent_positions >= 2 IS NOT REDUNDANT WITH THE FIRST CLAUSE: the first clause asserts a fresh-context derivation happened; the third asserts the council actually HOLDS two positions to compare. A fresh derivation that silently reproduces the original because the clerk was briefed with it satisfies the first and fails the third.
